addr: 480, 60 Feet Rd, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: I recently went to Açai and omg i loved their dark chocolate Açai bowl and protein mango smoothie. You can also try avocado feta toast, it has very rich avocado taste, a totally 10/10. Definitely going back there very soon.
Loved their dark chocolate bowl and mango protein smoothie, must try! Healthy and guilt free🥰 …

Please definitely get the mango acai bowl with the avocado feta toast. Tastes amazing and love how everything is so affordable and super healthy. Items are priced from 199-399 range and is situated right in the heart of Koramangala. Seating space is available too.
